== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[Fall Back! (PC Errata 2017 slip)]]. Compared with [[Fall Back! (PC Errata 2018 disc card)]] (by 24 January 2018). The disc card (lower part, scaled to the slip's width) and the 2017 slip; nothing else is edited. Made by placing the two crops side by side (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).

SHA-1 <code>066914afbe6711fb1ef3234d6a91ffef4705d29c</code>.

Fair use rationale: crops of copyrighted Star Wars Customizable Card Game card images, © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc. (errata by the Players Committee), used only to show the differences between versions on this non-commercial fan wiki.
